prompt: Make a programming tutorial thumbnail: a dark code editor screen slightly blurred in the background, a bright foreground focal area for huge title text, and a small React logo mark as a prop (not as the main subject). The text must be the hero.

checks.description: Overlay text is present, large, and readable; prefer exact or near-exact 'React in 15 Minutes'
Text keeps a safe margin from all four edges (not clipped by the border)
